definitions.explanation: ground meat made from a blend of beef and pork, commonly used in Japanese cooking

examples.japanese: ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合|あ}いびき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Mixed ground meat is used for hamburger steaks.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}いびき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧300⟦グラム→グラム：01354_guramu⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きて。
examples.english: Buy 300 grams of mixed ground meat.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}いびき{肉|にく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{玉|たま}ねぎ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧、⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I mixed the ground meat with onion and breadcrumbs to make the hamburger patty mixture.

notes:
A compound of {合|あ}いびき (mixed grinding) and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat). In Japan, {合|あ}いびき{肉|にく} almost always refers to a mixture of beef (⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧) and pork (⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧). The typical ratio is around 50:50 or 60:40 beef to pork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧: Japanese hamburger steak — the most iconic use
- ⟦ミートソース→ミートソース：30415_miitosoosu⟧: meat sauce (for pasta)
- ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧: dumplings
- ⟦メンチカツ→メンチカツ：15300_menchikatsu⟧: minced meat cutlet
- ⟦そぼろ→そぼろ：10383_soboro⟧: crumbled seasoned meat

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{牛|ぎゅう}ひき{肉|にく}→牛ひき肉：23362_gyuuhikiniku⟧: ground beef
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}→豚ひき肉：23445_butahikiniku⟧: ground pork
- ⟦{鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}→鶏ひき肉：23444_torihikiniku⟧: ground chicken
- ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧ / {挽|ひ}き{肉|にく}: ground meat (general term)

USAGE:
Sold at virtually every supermarket in Japan. The blend of beef and pork provides both the richness of beef and the juiciness of pork, making it the standard choice for home-cooked hamburger steaks.
